claims.text: Mr. Castañeda is a 71-year-old man with grade I degenerative spondylolisthesis at L4-L5 with dynamic instability and severe stenosis, first documented on 2025-10-15.

provenance.title: Office notes with neurological examination and ODI

claims.text: He reports low back pain and left leg pain in an L5 distribution, with neurogenic claudication limiting walking to one block.

provenance.title: Office notes with neurological examination and ODI

claims.text: He can no longer walk his dog or shop without a motorized cart, and he has given up golf.

provenance.title: Office notes with neurological examination and ODI
provenance.sourceQuote: unable to walk dog; motorized cart

claims.text: Flexion-extension radiographs demonstrate 4.5 mm of sagittal translation at L4-L5 between flexion and extension, with a Meyerding grade I (18%) slip.

Documented conservative care spans 40 weeks (2025-10-20 to 2026-07-28) and includes 18 sessions of physical therapy, celecoxib and gabapentin, and two left L4-L5 transforaminal epidural steroid injections with relief lasting under three weeks each.

provenance.title: Physical therapy, medication, and injection records

claims.text: Examination documents left great toe extension weakness (4/5) and diminished pinprick sensation over the left L5 dermatome, concordant with severe left lateral recess stenosis at L4-L5 on MRI.

provenance.title: Office notes with neurological examination and ODI

claims.text: MRI of the lumbar spine on 2026-04-15 shows grade I anterolisthesis at L4-L5 with severe central and left lateral recess stenosis.

claims.text: Urine cotinine was negative on 2026-08-20; nicotine cessation is documented from 2026-05-01.

criteria.text: Spondylolisthesis with documented instability on flexion-extension imaging
At least 12 weeks of conservative care including physical therapy and medication
Neurological deficit or neurogenic claudication concordant with imaging
Verified nicotine abstinence for at least 6 weeks before surgery
BMI and glycemic control within surgical safety thresholds
